title: Follow a quieter path.
description: Explore the real farm, one unhurried moment at a time.
mapNote: Route follows the hosts’ description. Positions are indicative, not surveyed or to scale.

stops.name: Arrival
stops.title: The world can wait.
stops.description: A gate. A slower pace. A farm that feels like your own.
stops.detail: Enter along the central road, with trees and lawn on your left. A right-hand branch leads to parking, roughly a hundred steps from the entrance. Your hosts welcome you into a working farm—not a fixed timetable.

stops.name: Parking
stops.title: Arrive. Then exhale.
stops.description: A right-hand branch from the entrance leads to parking.
stops.detail: Parking is roughly a hundred steps to the right of the gate, above the pond and arrival area. From here, return to the central path and follow the curve beside the water. Distances are approximate, based on the hosts’ description.
stops.imageAlt: The farm approach path in the evening

stops.name: The pond
stops.title: Follow the water.
stops.description: The road softens into an S. The pond stays on your right.
stops.detail: A large pond, described by the hosts as almost half an acre, opens near the beginning of the path. Parking is above this arrival area. Follow the curved road beside the water toward the main house.

stops.name: Main house
stops.title: At the heart of it all.
stops.description: Stone terraces. A welcoming verandah. A place to gather.
stops.detail: The main house sits at the far end of the pond. The library is beside it, and the guest-use kitchen is in front. To the right, stairs lead up to the two tree houses.

stops.name: Guest kitchen
stops.title: Make yourself at home.
stops.description: The kitchen is in front of the main house.
stops.detail: Guests can come together and cook their own meals here. Ask your hosts about kitchen access and arrangements before your visit. Aroha remains strictly vegetarian and alcohol-free.
stops.imageAlt: Stone terraces and steps at the main house

stops.name: The library
stops.title: A little room for a book.
stops.description: Beside the main house, another way to spend an unhurried afternoon.
stops.detail: Find the library beside the main house. Take a reading break between a walk, a meal and time outdoors.
stops.imageAlt: The shaded verandah beside the main house

stops.name: Tree houses
stops.title: A room in the palms.
stops.description: Take the stairs to the right of the main house.
stops.detail: Two raised rooms sit among the coconut palms. Step onto a private verandah, look through the leaves and open the door to explore the actual interior in the films. Your hosts can advise which accommodation suits your stay.
stops.imageAlt: Raised rooms seen through coconut palms at Aroha

stops.name: The cottages
stops.title: Stay close to the green.
stops.description: Behind the raised rooms, cottages settle into the greenery.
stops.detail: Discover the red-roofed A-frame cottages and the quieter corners behind the tree houses. Explore the accommodation styles below, then ask the hosts for a room recommendation. Farm Stay and Meditation & Wellness include overnight accommodation.

stops.name: Meditation hall
stops.title: Leave a little space.
stops.description: At the upper end of the farm, a place for stillness.
stops.detail: The meditation hall is the final stop up the farm. Meditation & Wellness guests can join guided sessions, wellness activities and sunrise mountain meditation. Participation leaves room to follow your own rhythm. The swimming pool is toward the left.

stops.name: Swimming pool
stops.title: And time to simply float.
stops.description: Toward the left of the meditation hall.
stops.detail: Swimming is included with all three visit packages. The pool is toward the left of the meditation hall. Ask the hosts about timings and supervision, and leave a little time for a swim between walks and meals.

stops.name: Farm life
stops.title: Come as guests.
stops.description: Leave with a little earth on your shoes. And a few new friends.
stops.detail: Meet the oxen and sheep with your hosts, wander through coconut groves and orchards, taste seasonal fruit and share strictly vegetarian farm food. There are more than 9,800 trees across 94 species here. Take part in what interests you.
